# The fixture org

The org's charter, the profile a GitHub organization shows, copied from its `.github` repository.

## What it holds

Its sites, each a project site under its own base.

## Where to start

The [orientation brief](https://github.com/JaimeStill/org/blob/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567/briefs/orientation.md)
in the org repository.
